sentences.text:
ORDER This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under section 482 of Cr.P.C for quashing the criminal proceedings in Spl.C.C.No.1805/2022 registered by R.T.Nagar Police Station in Crime No.109/2020 charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and Section 4(2) 5(L)
and Section 6 of Protection of children from sexual Offences (POCSO) Act 2012.

entities.text: Protection of children from sexual Offences (POCSO) Act 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. During the pendency of the petition, both the petitioner and respondent No.2 and 3 appeared before the court along with their counsels and have filed joint compromise application in I.A.No.2/2023 under section 482 of Cr.p.C read with 320 of Cr.P.C and submits that they have settled the dispute.
3. The petitioner is in judicial custody, therefore it is directed to the Jail Superintendent at Parappana Agrahara to produce petitioner/accused before the Court through video conference.
Accordingly petitioner was produced by the Jail Authority through video conference by the Jailer by name Sri.Shivbasappa .
4. The respondent No.3 is the victim, respondent No.2 is the complainant.

It is submitted by the learned petitioner counsel as well as counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 that prior to the filing of this petition and registering the case, the petitioner and respondent No.2 had fallen in love, they had Harshad Khan vs State Of Karnataka on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67714129/
2 eloped and married.

sentences.text: Also the child was already born to the respondent No.2 when the case was registered by the police and the charge sheet also reveals the same.

This court in catena of decisions relied upon the decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court and other coordinate bench, wherein the criminal proceedings had been quashed in the interest of the life of the victim and the child born to the accused as well as victim girl.

Today the victim girl is present along with the child, she is said to have already attained the age of majority and her date of birth is stated to be 23.02.2033 and as on '2023; she is already running 20 years and she is going to complete 20 years by the next month.
Such being the case, she is capable of understanding and can give the consent for compromise.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner and respondent No2. already married and having child, ofcourse she was a minor and was below 18 years, at the time of incident,
but while filing the charge sheet she has already attained the age of majority and she has come forward for settling the issues.
In the interest of the life of the victim and the male child born, out of their wedlock, this court deed it is fit and proper to allow the parties to compound the offence.
Hence, I.A.No.2/2023 is allowed.
Accordingly, this petition is allowed.
Consequently, the criminal proceedings against the petitioner in Spl.C.C.No.1805/2022 registered by R.T.Nagar Police Station in Crime No.109/2020, is hereby quashed.
In view of disposal of this petition, I.A.No.1/2023 does not survive for consideration..
The petitioner is set at liberty.

Office to intimate to the to the jail authority as well as to the concerned trial court for taking further course of action.
